::::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-8}
My work sits at the intersection of **geography, climate and public health**: spatial analysis, GIS and data visualization to understand how places and extreme climate events affect people's health. At the **Laboratory of Geography, Environment and Health (LAGAS/UnB)**, I work on GeoCalor and develop localdatasus.

[Health geography]{.chip} [Spatial epidemiology]{.chip} [Climate and heat waves]{.chip} [Remote sensing]{.chip} [Dashboards]{.chip} [R · Python · QGIS · ArcGIS · PostGIS]{.chip}
